headline: Bloom Energy Third-Quarter Revenue Surges 138% Despite Stock Decline
summary: Bloom Energy reported a 138% year-over-year surge in third-quarter 2026 revenue. However, shares of the clean energy fuel cell provider fell following the announcement.
why: Bloom Energy manufactures solid oxide fuel cells that generate electricity for commercial and industrial facilities, including data centers.

impacts.name: Bloom Energy Corporation
impacts.why: Shares fell post-earnings as market expectations outpaced reported performance figures.

why_moved: Despite strong top-line revenue growth, the stock declined due to investor scrutiny over profitability and elevated expectations in the clean energy technology sector.
